title: [29.x] Subcontractor Price ignores Run Time when creating purchase cost for time-based subcontracting operations
summary: Subcontractor price calculation for time-based operations now correctly multiplies the unit cost by the operation's run time factor when creating purchase requisitions and orders.
key_points: Time-based operation cost factor was being ignored in subcontractor price calculations
Added shared calculation that multiplies subcontractor price by operation time and rounds to configured precision
Fix applied consistently to requisition lines, carried-out purchases, repricing, and direct purchase line creation
Comprehensive test coverage for all pricing scenarios in time-based subcontracting
Affects purchase cost accuracy in manufacturing operations using subcontractors
quote: The operation's run time was not included, resulting in an incorrect Direct Unit Cost on requisition worksheet and purchase lines.
